title: kbingest map copies repository-controlled MSBuild property values into the map
goal: DotnetMapper keeps an evaluated value only when it fits its expected shape (a TFM, a LangVersion token, a NuGet package id and version) and notes the rest, and the map document is scanned with the leak shapes (SECRET_TEXT / kbcommon.leak_hits) before it is written, so a property function such as $([System.IO.File]::ReadAllText(...)) cannot carry a local file or environment value into the map and from there into kb facts; a test named kbingest_map_dotnet_value_shapes with a planted value proves it (sprint SP-fkyrld5h review finding F6)
